name: retired-overspender
facts:
Goal: maximize wealth at the end of the plan (terminal wealth), planning to age 90.
- Age 60, single filer, retired this year at 60.
- No more income from work and nothing more to save: gross income $0, savings $0.
- Wants to spend $200,000 a year in retirement.
- Balances: $100,000 traditional (pre-tax), $50,000 Roth, $50,000 taxable brokerage.
- Leave Social Security and pensions out of the plan. No employer match.
- Happy with the assistant's default assumptions for everything else.
